newsitem.title: USA: Hicks, Muse, Tate to buy Lucent unit.
newsitem.headline: Hicks, Muse, Tate to buy Lucent unit.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc said on Thursday it was selling the printed circuit board and backplane business of its microelectronics group to investment firm Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc for an undisclosed sum.

The business, which has revenues in the "hundreds of millions of dollars" according to a Lucent spokesman, was first put up for sale in January. The transaction is expected to close by the end of the year.
The unit employs 2,100 people and is based in Richmond, Virginia. Hicks Muse's affiliate for commercial and industrial acquisitions, Mills & Partners, worked on the deal.
The largest customer of the unit following the sale will continue to be Lucent itself, the company said.

It added that Hicks Muse said it would use the Richmond works as a cornerstone of a global printed circuit board and backplane business. Backplanes connect circuit boards to each other within a device. -- Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1712
